scope: R4 first bone coat wave and remaining three skins; global R6 compatibility/performance matrix pending

pig.reviewed_by: Codex: direct final baseline/candidate, real Release full-cycle motion, world and 64px icon inspection; not user sign-off
pig.notes: Familiar species anatomy and own material pattern. Original backend and procedural animation profiles retained. Sheep head/body proportions revised against baseline; fox ears reduced; wolf chest/leg/neck coplanar faces removed. Actual skeletal rest geometry frames the preview without changing gameplay bounds. Three skins explicitly built on the matching geometry and inspected separately in motion and world.
